verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local LLM runtime and server (llama.cpp/MLX, OpenAI-like endpoints, headless llmster daemon), so prefill/decode disaggregation is a fair serving-performance axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions disaggregating prefill and decode phases or any large-scale distributed serving architecture. A community user even describes moving to vLLM after testing in LM Studio.
